registry.note: The profiles below were specified AFTER the 2022-2026 results were known. They are appended to the prior count, never substituted for it.

campaign_bootstrap_usd.assumptions: PRIMARY. Resamples campaign net P&L in dollars, so a campaign that risked three sleeves counts for what it actually made rather than being normalised away. This is the test of whether the average campaign is profitable after every modelled cost.

block_monthly.assumptions: PRIMARY. Resamples whole monthly blocks so serial dependence inside a block is preserved. The effective sample is the number of blocks (56), not the number of days (1446) - which is the honest count and the reason the interval is wide.

block_quarterly.assumptions: PRIMARY. Resamples whole quarterly blocks so serial dependence inside a block is preserved. The effective sample is the number of blocks (19), not the number of days (1446) - which is the honest count and the reason the interval is wide.

deflated_sharpe.reason: insufficient_inputs: needs >= 2 trials, a positive spread of trial Sharpes and >= 30 observations. Run experiments.py, which supplies all three.

target_050_comparison.note: NOT the override. This raises the SIZING TARGET to 0.50 %, which changes every position size. The override leaves the target at 0.10 % and only permits a single minimum lot.

baseline_strict.note: Probability the true Sharpe exceeds zero AFTER deflating for the number of configurations examined. Below 0.95 is not evidence of skill.

small_account_override.note: Probability the true Sharpe exceeds zero AFTER deflating for the number of configurations examined. Below 0.95 is not evidence of skill.
